proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIRMAN
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt a policy requiring the Chair of the Board to be an independent member of the Board, whenever possible.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING EMPLOYEE PRACTICES IN ISRAEL/PALESTINE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board make all possible lawful efforts to implement and/or increase activity on eight Holy Land Principles on fair employment practices.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON CONDUCTING BUSINESS IN CONFLICT-AFFECTED AREAS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing approach to mitigating ethical and business risks of business activities in conflict-affected areas, including belligerent occupation.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON BOARD OVERSIGHT OF PRODUCT SAFETY AND QUALITY
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating strengthening Board expertise in product quality and safety, adopting an independent chair, and other governance improvements.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
